title: CrystalXRD-Bench: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for XRD Peak Indexing Across Diverse Crystalline Materials
comment: 18 pages, 10 figures
summary: Miller-index identification from powder XRD patterns requires capabilities untested by existing multimodal benchmarks: the model must read a narrow peak location from a rendered scientific curve and then connect that observation to multi-step crystallographic reasoning. We introduce CrystalXRD-Bench, a 250-sample benchmark built from 10 public crystallographic databases for a single task: recover the full set of HKLs contributing to the highest-intensity peak in an XRD pattern. Each sample pairs the rendered XRD image with the source CIF text and chemical formula, so visual extraction errors and reasoning errors can be examined side by side. We evaluate seven vision-language models. The best Jaccard score is 0.5888 (GPT-5.4) with an exact-match rate of 37.6%, yet six of seven models remain below Jaccard 0.50; the task is far from solved. Error patterns vary systematically: double-peak cases are especially brittle, recall-heavy models gain coverage by over-predicting HKLs, and access to CIF text does not close the gap in crystallographic calculation. Alongside model rankings, the benchmark identifies the conditions under which current VLMs fail on quantitative scientific figures. All data and evaluation code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出了CrystalXRD-Bench基准，用于评估视觉语言模型从粉末XRD图案中识别米勒指数的能力，发现当前最佳模型（GPT-5.4）的Jaccard得分仅为0.5888，任务远未解决。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态基准无法测试模型从科学曲线中读取窄峰位置并进行多步晶体学推理的能力，需要专门评估视觉语言模型在定量科学图表上的表现。
AI.method: 构建250样本基准CrystalXRD-Bench，每个样本包含XRD图像、源CIF文本和化学式，要求模型恢复最高强度峰对应的完整HKL集合，同时对比视觉提取误差和推理误差。
AI.result: GPT-5.4最佳Jaccard得分0.5888，精确匹配率37.6%；六款模型低于0.50；双峰情况特别脆弱，过度预测HKL可提高覆盖但牺牲精度，CIF文本无法弥补晶体学计算差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型在定量科学图表任务上远未解决，基准揭示了模型在特定条件下的失败模式，所有数据和代码将公开。
idea_en: A method for automatically identifying Miller indices (HKL sets) from powder XRD pattern images by integrating visual peak detection with crystallographic reasoning, enabling automated phase identification without human expertise.

A benchmark evaluation framework (CrystalXRD-Bench) that pairs rendered XRD images with source CIF text and chemical formulas, allowing side-by-side analysis of visual extraction errors versus crystallographic reasoning errors.
A multi-step reasoning pipeline that connects peak location extraction from scientific curve renderings to crystallographic calculation for complete HKL recovery.
A systematic error analysis methodology for vision-language models on quantitative scientific figures, identifying failure conditions such as double-peak brittleness and over-prediction patterns.
idea_ch: 一种从粉末XRD图案图像中自动识别米勒指数(HKL集)的方法，通过集成视觉峰值检测与晶体学推理，实现无需人工专业知识的自动物相识别。
一种基准评估框架(CrystalXRD-Bench)，将渲染的XRD图像与源CIF文本和化学式配对，允许并排分析视觉提取误差与晶体学推理误差。
一种多步推理流水线，将科学曲线渲染中的峰位提取与HKL完全恢复的晶体学计算相连接。
一种视觉语言模型在定量科学图表上的系统误差分析方法，识别双峰脆性、过度预测模式等失败条件。

title: VitalAgent: A Tool-Augmented Agent for Reactive and Proactive Physiological Monitoring over Wearable Health Data
summary: Wearable devices enable continuous monitoring of physiological signals such as ECG and PPG, but existing mHealth systems are largely limited to task-specific prediction pipelines or reactive question answering over static summaries. They lack the ability to support temporal reasoning, persistent physiological context, and proactive monitoring over long-term signal streams. We propose VitalAgent, a tool-augmented agentic framework for ECG/PPG-based mHealth that supports both reactive question answering and proactive monitoring. VitalAgent is built on a longitudinal physiological memory and a tool-augmented reasoning interface that enables dynamic computation over raw signals. We further introduce VitalBench, a longitudinal physiological monitoring benchmark dataset comprising 1,862 QA pairs for reactive question answering and 90.2 hours of continuous ECG/PPG recordings for proactive monitoring, covering cardiac, physical activity, and stress-related tasks. Experiments demonstrate that VitalAgent achieves over 30% improvement over prompt-based and ReAct baselines in reactive evaluation and supports proactive alert monitoring over long-term physiological signals, highlighting the importance of dynamic tool use and long-term physiological monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出VitalAgent——一种面向可穿戴设备ECG/PPG信号的工具增强型智能体框架，支持反应式问答和主动式监测，并构建了VitalBench基准数据集，实验表明相比基线方法提升超30%。
AI.motivation: 现有mHealth系统局限于任务特定的预测管道或静态摘要的被动问答，缺乏对长时间信号流的时序推理、持续生理上下文和主动监测能力。
AI.method: VitalAgent构建在纵向生理记忆（longitudinal physiological memory）和工具增强推理接口之上，支持对原始信号的动态计算；同时构建VitalBench基准数据集，包含1862个QA对和90.2小时连续ECG/PPG记录。
AI.result: 在反应式评估中相比prompt-based和ReAct基线提升超30%，并支持对长时间生理信号的主动警报监测。
AI.conclusion: 动态工具使用和长期生理监测对于mHealth智能体至关重要，VitalAgent在时序推理和主动监测方面具有显著优势。
idea_en: A tool-augmented agentic framework for ECG/PPG-based mHealth with longitudinal physiological memory that maintains persistent context across long-term signal streams.
A dual-mode system supporting both reactive question answering and proactive monitoring on continuous physiological signals.
VitalBench benchmark dataset comprising 1,862 QA pairs for reactive evaluation and 90.2 hours of continuous ECG/PPG recordings for proactive monitoring tasks.
A dynamic tool-use reasoning interface enabling real-time computation and analysis over raw physiological signal streams.
A proactive alert monitoring mechanism that triggers notifications based on longitudinal physiological pattern analysis beyond threshold-based rules.
idea_ch: 基于纵向生理记忆的ECG/PPG移动健康工具增强型智能体框架，在长时间信号流中保持持续上下文
支持反应式问答与主动式监测双模式切换的系统设计，可同时处理即时查询和持续生理监控
VitalBench基准数据集——包含1862个问答对用于反应式评估、90.2小时连续ECG/PPG记录用于主动监测任务
动态工具使用推理接口，可对原始生理信号流进行实时计算和分析
基于纵向生理模式分析的主动警报监测机制，超越传统阈值触发的规则式报警

title: The Curse of Helpfulness: Inverse Scaling Law in Robustness to Distractor Instructions via DistractionIF
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in agentic and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, where they must execute user-specified tasks over externally provided reference text. In practice, such context is often unstructured and contaminated with benign but instruction-like semantic noise, such as editorial comments and system traces, which should be treated strictly as data. We introduce DistractionIF, a benchmark designed to evaluate robustness against such distractor instructions in reference text. Across a broad range of models, we observe a consistent inverse scaling phenomenon: larger models are often less robust, with performance dropping by up to 30 points as scale increases. Mechanistically, our perplexity analysis reveals that scaling erodes the probabilistic boundary between robust and distracted behaviors, making models increasingly prone to over-interpreting noise as instructions. To address this, we demonstrate that reinforcement learning, specifically Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), can restore this boundary, improving robustness by up to 15.5% without compromising general instruction-following capability. Our findings highlight a critical instruction-following robustness gap in reference-grounded tasks and establish reinforcement learning as a promising path for enforcing strict data-instruction separation at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DistractionIF基准，评估LLM在RAG和代理系统中对外部参考文本中干扰性指令的鲁棒性。发现模型越大越易被干扰（逆缩放现象），原因在于缩放模糊了鲁棒与分心行为的概率边界。使用GRPO强化学习可恢复该边界，提升鲁棒性达15.5%。
AI.motivation: LLM在RAG和代理系统中需执行用户任务，但外部参考文本常含有类指令语义噪声（如编辑评论、系统痕迹），这些应被视为数据而非指令。现有模型对此类干扰缺乏鲁棒性评估与解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建DistractionIF基准，包含带干扰指令的参考文本测试集。2) 在多种模型上进行鲁棒性评估，分析逆缩放现象。3) 通过困惑度分析揭示缩放对概率边界的影响。4) 采用GRPO强化学习训练，恢复鲁棒与分心行为之间的概率边界。
AI.result: 较大模型鲁棒性下降达30个百分点；GRPO可将鲁棒性提升15.5%，且不损害通用指令跟随能力。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了参考接地任务中指令跟随鲁棒性缺口，强化学习是强制大规模数据-指令分离的有前景路径。
idea_en: A benchmark (DistractionIF) for evaluating LLM robustness against distractor instructions embedded in external reference text, specifically designed for RAG and agentic systems.

A method using GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) reinforcement learning to enhance robustness by restoring the probabilistic boundary between robust and distracted instruction-following behaviors.
A perplexity-based analysis framework to quantify the erosion of probabilistic boundaries between robust and distracted behaviors as model scale increases.
A training paradigm that enforces strict data-instruction separation in LLMs without compromising general instruction-following capability.
idea_ch: 一种用于评估LLM对外部参考文本中干扰指令鲁棒性的基准测试方法（DistractionIF），特别针对RAG和代理系统设计
一种利用GRPO（组相对策略优化）强化学习恢复鲁棒行为与分心行为之间概率边界的方法，可提升鲁棒性15.5%

title: Xetrieval: Mechanistically Explaining Dense Retrieval
comment: Code: https://github.com/Hihiczx/Xetrieval ; Project page: https://hihiczx.github.io/Xetrieval
summary: Explaining why dense retrievers assign high relevance scores remains challenging because retrieval decisions are made through opaque high-dimensional embeddings. Existing explanations often focus on surface signals, such as lexical matches, token alignments, or post-hoc textual rationales, and thus provide limited insight into the latent factors that shape dense retrieval behavior at the embedding level. We propose \textit{Xetrieval}, an embedding-level mechanistic framework for explaining dense retrieval. \textit{Xetrieval} first introduces a lightweight reasoning internalizer that approximates Chain-of-Thought reasoning directly in the embedding space with a single forward pass, enriching sentence embeddings with reasoning-oriented information while avoiding expensive autoregressive generation. It then decomposes these reasoning-enhanced embeddings into sparse, human-interpretable features, each associated with a coherent natural language description. By aggregating sparse feature overlaps across multiple document-side views, \textit{Xetrieval} provides feature-level explanations of individual retrieval decisions. Experiments on diverse retrievers and benchmarks show that \textit{Xetrieval} uncovers coherent interpretable features, yields stronger pair-level intervention effects, and supports task-level feature steering. The project page and source code are available at https://hihiczx.github.io/Xetrieval .

AI.tldr: Xetrieval提出了一种嵌入层面的可解释性框架，通过轻量级推理内化器将链式推理融入嵌入空间，再分解为稀疏可解释特征，从而解释密集检索模型的高相关性评分。
AI.motivation: 现有的密集检索解释方法多依赖表层信号（如词法匹配、token对齐或事后文本解释），无法揭示嵌入空间中影响检索决策的潜在因素。
AI.method: 1) 引入轻量级推理内化器（Reasoning Internalizer），以单次前向传播在嵌入空间中近似链式推理，避免昂贵的自回归生成；2) 将推理增强的嵌入分解为稀疏、人类可解释的特征，每个特征对应自然语言描述；3) 聚合多文档侧的稀疏特征重叠，提供特征级别的检索决策解释。
AI.result: 在多种检索器和基准上，Xetrieval能够发现连贯的可解释特征，产生更强的成对干预效果，并支持任务级特征引导。
AI.conclusion: Xetrieval为密集检索提供了嵌入层面可解释的机制框架，填补了现有方法在揭示嵌入层潜在因素方面的空白。
idea_en: A lightweight reasoning internalizer that approximates Chain-of-Thought reasoning in embedding space with a single forward pass, enriching sentence embeddings with reasoning-oriented information without autoregressive generation.
A method for decomposing reasoning-enhanced dense embeddings into sparse, human-interpretable features, each associated with a coherent natural language description.
A feature-level explanation framework for dense retrieval that aggregates sparse feature overlaps across multiple document-side views to explain individual retrieval decisions.
An embedding-level mechanistic framework (Xetrieval) that bridges the gap between opaque high-dimensional embeddings and interpretable retrieval explanations.
A task-level feature steering mechanism that leverages the discovered interpretable features to influence and control dense retrieval behavior.

一种面向密集检索的特征级解释框架，通过聚合多个文档侧的稀疏特征重叠来解释单个检索决策。

title: MINDGAMES: A Live Arena for Evaluating Social and Strategic Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as interactive agents, yet their capacity for social and strategic reasoning over extended interaction remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations rely on static vignettes or single-game benchmarks that cannot capture the sustained, multi-faceted reasoning that real-world multi-agent settings demand. We introduce Mindgames, a multi-game arena and evaluation platform for LLM agents that operationalizes complementary reasoning demands relevant to ``theory of mind'': belief attribution under hidden information, opponent modeling through repeated strategic interaction, cooperative inference under knowledge asymmetries, and sustained deception in social deduction. Built on TextArena, Mindgames provides a unified interaction interface, TrueSkill-based rating, and full trajectory logging across four game environments. We instantiate Mindgames through a 2025 competition cycle hosted at a major AI conference, which assessed 944 submitted agents from 76 teams across four games: Colonel Blotto, Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma, Codenames, and Secret Mafia. Our analysis surfaces both agent-level and evaluation-level limitations: brittle rule adherence remains a major bottleneck, top-performing systems repeatedly rely on explicit structural scaffolding, and leaderboard validity differs sharply across environments. In particular, failure-heavy environments can reward robustness to opponent errors as much as strategic ability, with Secret Mafia exhibiting a pronounced error-survival confound in this cycle. We release a dataset of 29,571 multi-agent games with turn-level observations, actions, and rewards, together with MG-Ref, a deterministic offline tournament protocol that scores new agents against a frozen reference pool of top-ranked, low-error Stage~II submissions under the same error-attribution lens used in this analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Mindgames——一个多游戏竞技场和评估平台，用于测试LLM智能体在理论心智、对手建模、合作推理和社会欺骗等方面的持续多面推理能力。基于2025年AI会议竞赛，分析了944个提交智能体在四款游戏中的表现，揭示了智能体和评估层面的局限性，并发布了包含29571场多智能体游戏轨迹的数据集及MG-Ref离线评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体评估依赖静态情景或单一游戏基准，无法捕捉真实多智能体场景所需的持续、多面推理能力（如信念归因、对手建模、合作推理和社会欺骗）。
AI.method: 基于TextArena构建Mindgames平台，集成四款游戏环境（Colonel Blotto、Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma、Codenames、Secret Mafia），采用TrueSkill评级系统和完整轨迹日志。通过2025年AI会议竞赛收集944个智能体进行评估，并设计MG-Ref离线锦标赛协议对智能体进行标准化评分。
AI.result: 规则遵循的脆弱性是主要瓶颈；顶级系统依赖显式结构脚手架；不同环境下的排行榜有效性差异显著；在失败密集型环境中（如Secret Mafia），对对手错误的鲁棒性与战略能力存在混淆。
AI.conclusion: 发布了包含29571场多智能体游戏的数据集和MG-Ref离线评估协议，有助于更准确地评估LLM智能体的多面推理能力。
idea_en: A multi-game evaluation platform (Mindgames) that operationalizes complementary reasoning demands including belief attribution under hidden information, opponent modeling, cooperative inference under knowledge asymmetries, and sustained deception in social deduction, enabling comprehensive assessment of LLM agents' theory of mind capabilities.
A TrueSkill-based unified rating system for multi-agent game environments that enables cross-game comparison and ranking of LLM agent performance across different strategic reasoning tasks.

A deterministic offline tournament protocol (MG-Ref) that scores new agents against a frozen reference pool of top-ranked, low-error submissions, enabling fair and reproducible evaluation under controlled error-attribution conditions.

A methodology for detecting and quantifying the error-survival confound in failure-heavy multi-agent environments, where robustness to opponent errors can be conflated with strategic ability, as demonstrated in the Secret Mafia game.

title: DeepSurvey: Enhancing Analytical Depth and Citation Reliability in Automated Survey Generation
summary: As scientific literature grows rapidly, automated survey generation has become a key capability for AI scientists and human researchers. However, existing systems suffer from limited analytical depth due to reliance on abstracts and isolated paper processing, and unreliable citations from imprecise retrieval and post-hoc grounding, producing superficial surveys and may mislead researchers. We present DeepSurvey, an agentic system that addresses both. To enhance depth, DeepSurvey extracts structured keynotes from full-text papers, models cross-paper relationships through clustering and comparative analysis, and integrates code-repository analysis to recover implementation-level details. To fortify reliability, it combines citation-graph expansion with hybrid filtering for topic-focussed retrieval, enforces evidence-constrained citation assignment, and deploys multi-granularity agentic refinement to validate citation-claim alignment. Experiments show that DeepSurvey achieves the highest content score (8.644/10) and citation quality (12.3% and 9.3% recall and precision gains over the strongest baseline), generalizes more robustly across domains (0.14 vs 0.22 to 0.69 CS-to-non-CS drop), and is preferred over human-written surveys by domain experts (83.3% overall quality, 100% content depth).

AI.tldr: DeepSurvey是一个智能体系统，通过全文本结构化笔记提取、跨论文关系建模、代码仓库分析增强深度，并通过引文图扩展、混合过滤、证据约束引用分配和多粒度智能体精炼提升可靠性，在内容评分和引用质量上超越现有基线，专家偏好率达83.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有自动综述生成系统存在两个主要问题：(1) 分析深度有限——过度依赖摘要和孤立论文处理；(2) 引用不可靠——不精确的检索和后验接地导致虚假引用，产生肤浅的综述甚至误导研究人员。
AI.method: (1) 深度增强：从全文中提取结构化关键笔记；通过聚类和比较分析建模跨论文关系；集成代码仓库分析恢复实现级细节。(2) 可靠性强化：结合引文图扩展与混合过滤进行主题聚焦检索；执行证据约束的引用分配；部署多粒度智能体精炼验证引用-声明对齐。
AI.result: DeepSurvey在内容评分（8.644/10）和引用质量（召回率和精确率分别比最强基线提升12.3%和9.3%）上达到最高；跨领域泛化更稳健（CS到非CS领域性能下降0.14，对比基线下降0.22-0.69）；领域专家偏好率达83.3%（整体质量）和100%（内容深度）。
AI.conclusion: DeepSurvey通过深度融合全文本分析与智能体引用验证机制，显著提升了自动综述生成的深度和可靠性，专家评估表明其质量已超越人类撰写的综述。
idea_en: A method for automated survey generation that extracts structured keynotes from full-text papers (not just abstracts) and models cross-paper relationships via clustering and comparative analysis to enhance analytical depth.

A citation reliability framework that combines citation-graph expansion with hybrid filtering for topic-focused retrieval, and enforces evidence-constrained citation assignment to prevent hallucinated or irrelevant citations.
A multi-granularity agentic refinement mechanism that validates citation-claim alignment through iterative agent-based checking at multiple granularity levels.
Integration of code-repository analysis into scientific survey generation to recover implementation-level details that are missing from text-only analysis.
A hybrid filtering system for citation-graph expansion that balances topic relevance and citation network connectivity to improve retrieval precision.

一种多粒度智能体精炼机制，通过迭代的基于智能体的检查在多个粒度级别上验证引用与声明的对齐一致性。
将代码仓库分析集成到科学综述生成中，以恢复纯文本分析中缺失的实现级细节信息。
一种用于引文图扩展的混合过滤系统，平衡主题相关性和引文网络连通性以提高检索精度。

title: UI-KOBE: Knowledge-Oriented Behavior Exploration for Lightweight Graph-Guided GUI Agents
summary: Recent advances in mobile GUI agents have shown strong potential for automating mobile tasks, but most effective systems still depend on large vision-language models for screenshot understanding and long-horizon planning. Small GUI agents that can be deployed directly on mobile devices are more attractive for practical use, offering lower inference cost and better protection of sensitive on-device information. However, due to limited model capacity, such lightweight agents remain unreliable when planning and executing GUI tasks end-to-end from screenshots alone. We propose Knowledge-Oriented Behavior Exploration (\textbf{UI-KOBE}), a framework that improves lightweight mobile GUI agents with reusable app-specific graph knowledge. UI-KOBE first autonomously explores a mobile application and constructs an app knowledge graph, where nodes represent distinct UI states and edges represent executable transitions. At runtime, a lightweight GUI agent uses the graph as external guidance: given a user task and the current screenshot, it identifies the current graph node and selects among self-loop actions, neighboring transitions, task completion, or fallback free actions associated with that node. By supporting runtime decisions with app-specific graph guidance, UI-KOBE reduces the burden of end-to-end GUI planning and helps lightweight models perform mobile GUI tasks more effectively, offering a practical step toward efficient, interpretable, and privacy-conscious on-device GUI agents.

AI.tldr: 提出UI-KOBE框架，通过自主构建应用知识图谱（节点=UI状态，边=可执行转换）来增强轻量级移动GUI代理，使其无需依赖大型视觉语言模型即可在设备端高效执行任务。
AI.motivation: 现有轻量级GUI代理由于模型容量有限，在仅凭截图端到端规划和执行GUI任务时不可靠，而大型视觉语言模型虽效果好但推理成本高且存在隐私风险。
AI.method: 1) 自主探索移动应用并构建知识图谱（节点=UI状态，边=可执行转换）；2) 运行时轻量级代理利用该图谱作为外部指导，根据用户任务和当前截图识别当前节点，选择自循环动作、邻接转换、任务完成或回退自由动作。
AI.result: 通过应用特定的图谱指导减少端到端GUI规划的负担，帮助轻量级模型更有效地执行移动GUI任务。
AI.conclusion: UI-KOBE提供了迈向高效、可解释且隐私保护的设备端GUI代理的实用步骤。
idea_en: A method for constructing an app-specific knowledge graph by autonomously exploring a mobile application, where nodes represent distinct UI states and edges represent executable transitions between states.

A runtime decision mechanism for lightweight GUI agents that uses a pre-constructed app knowledge graph to identify the current UI state from a screenshot and select among actions including self-loop actions, neighboring transitions, task completion, or fallback free actions.
A framework that reduces end-to-end GUI planning burden on lightweight models by providing external app-specific graph guidance, enabling on-device deployment without large vision-language models.
A privacy-conscious on-device GUI agent architecture that keeps sensitive information on the device by using lightweight models guided by locally stored app knowledge graphs.

title: Opt-Verifier: Unleashing the Power of LLMs for Optimization Modeling via Dual-Side Verification
summary: Building mathematical optimization models is critical in operations research (OR), while it requires substantial human expertise. Recent advancements have utilized large language models (LLMs) to automate this modeling process. However, existing works often struggle to verify the correctness of the generated optimization models, without checking the rationality of the constraints and variables or the validity of solutions to the generated models. This hampers the subsequent verification and correction steps, and thus it severely hurts the modeling accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose a novel LLM-based framework with Dual-side Verification (Opt-Verifier) from both structure and solution perspectives, thereby improving the modeling accuracy. The structure-side verification ensures that the modeling structure of the generated optimization models aligns with the original problem description, accurately capturing the problem's constraints and requirements. Meanwhile, the solution-side verification interprets and evaluates the solutions' validity, confirming that the optimization models are logically and mathematically sound. Experiments on popular benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves over 20\% improvement in accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于大语言模型的双侧验证框架（Opt-Verifier），从结构侧和求解侧两个维度验证自动生成的优化模型，将建模准确率提升了20%以上。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动化数学优化建模工作无法有效验证生成模型的正确性，缺乏对约束和变量合理性的检查，严重影响建模准确性。
AI.method: 提出Opt-Verifier框架，包含结构侧验证（确保模型结构与原问题描述一致，准确捕获约束和需求）和求解侧验证（解释和评估解的合法性，确保模型逻辑和数学上的合理性）。
AI.result: 在公开基准测试上，该方法将建模准确率提升了20%以上。
AI.conclusion: 从结构和求解双维度验证自动化生成的优化模型，能有效提升建模准确性，为LLM在运筹学领域的应用提供了更可靠的解决方案。
idea_en: Dual-side verification framework for LLM-generated optimization models, combining structural verification (checking constraint and variable alignment with problem description) and solution-side verification (interpreting and evaluating solution validity)

Solution-side verification mechanism that interprets and evaluates the logical and mathematical soundness of solutions to LLM-generated optimization models

title: Battery-Sim-Agent: Leveraging LLM-Agent for Inverse Battery Parameter Estimation
summary: Parameterizing high-fidelity "digital twins" of batteries is a critical yet challenging inverse problem that hinders the pace of battery innovation. Prevailing methods formulate this as a black-box optimization (BBO) task, employing algorithms that are sample-inefficient and blind to the underlying physics. In this work, we introduce a new paradigm that reframes the inverse problem as a reasoning task, and present Battery-Sim-Agent, the first framework to deploy a Large Language Model (LLM) agent in a closed loop with a high-fidelity battery simulator. The agent mimics a human scientist's workflow: it interprets rich, multi-modal feedback from the simulator, forms physically-grounded hypotheses to explain discrepancies, and proposes structured parameter updates. On a systematically constructed benchmark suite spanning diverse battery chemistries, operating conditions, and difficulty levels, our agent significantly outperforms strong BBO baselines like Bayesian optimization in identifying accurate parameters. We further demonstrate the framework's capability in complex long-horizon degradation fitting tasks and validate its practical applicability on real-world battery datasets. Our results highlight the promise of LLM-agents as reasoning-based optimizers for scientific discovery and battery parameter estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Battery-Sim-Agent框架，将LLM智能体与高保真电池模拟器闭环结合，通过物理推理方式解决电池数字孪生参数反演问题，性能优于传统黑箱优化方法。
AI.motivation: 电池"数字孪生"的高保真参数化是一个关键但具有挑战性的反问题，现有黑箱优化方法样本效率低且忽视底层物理机制，亟需更智能的参数估计范式。
AI.method: 将反问题重构为推理任务，利用LLM智能体闭环连接高保真电池模拟器，模拟科学家工作流：解读多模态反馈、形成物理解释假设、提出结构化参数更新。
AI.result: 在涵盖多种电池化学体系、工况和难度级别的基准测试上，该方法显著优于贝叶斯优化等强BBO基线；在长周期退化拟合和真实电池数据集上验证了实用性。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体可作为基于推理的优化器用于科学发现和电池参数估计，为电池创新提供了新范式。

title: ParaTool: Shifting Tool Representations from Context to Parameters
summary: Tool calling extends large language models (LLMs) by enabling grounded interaction with external executable interfaces, thereby supporting environment-coupled problem solving. However, mainstream in-context learning (ICL) approaches typically incorporate detailed tool documentation and usage examples directly into the context. This results in substantial inference overhead and heightened risks of hallucination as the context length grows. Conversely, while tuning-based methods improve general tool-calling capabilities, they often fail to effectively internalize the specific details of previously seen tools, thereby retaining a dependency on in-context documentation. To address these limitations, we propose ParaTool, a framework that projects each tool into a dedicated, loadable set of parameters. By equipping a dynamic integration of these parameterized tools, the LLM can perform tool calling without relying on in-context documents or examples. Specifically, our approach consists of three stages: (1) parametric tool pre-training encapsulates the knowledge of different tools into independent parameter modules; (2) soft tool selection employs a gating network to dynamically weigh and aggregate relevant tool parameters; and (3) parametric tool fine-tuning jointly updates tool parameters to align the training and inference processes. Experiments on Stable ToolBench and BFCL demonstrate that ParaTool significantly outperforms strong ICL-based baselines, achieving superior performance while reducing computational complexity.

AI.tldr: ParaTool提出将每个工具投影为独立的可加载参数模块，通过参数化工具预训练、软工具选择和参数化工具微调三阶段，使LLM无需依赖上下文文档即可进行工具调用，在降低计算复杂度的同时提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 现有工具调用方法中，上下文学习(ICL)方式需将详细工具文档和示例放入上下文，导致推理开销大、幻觉风险高；而基于微调的方法虽提升通用工具调用能力，但未能有效内化已见工具的具体细节，仍依赖上下文文档。ParaTool旨在解决这些限制。
AI.method: ParaTool包含三个阶段：(1)参数化工具预训练——将不同工具的知识封装为独立参数模块；(2)软工具选择——通过门控网络动态加权和聚合相关工具参数；(3)参数化工具微调——联合更新工具参数以对齐训练和推理过程。
AI.result: 在Stable ToolBench和BFCL数据集上，ParaTool显著优于基于ICL的强基线方法，在实现更优性能的同时降低了计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: ParaTool通过参数化工具模块实现了免上下文文档的工具调用，有效解决了传统方法中的推理开销和幻觉问题，验证了参数化工具调用的可行性。
idea_en: A method for parametric tool pre-training that encapsulates knowledge of different tools into independent parameter modules, enabling LLMs to perform tool calling without relying on in-context documentation.
A soft tool selection mechanism using a gating network to dynamically weigh and aggregate relevant tool parameters for multi-tool scenarios.
A parametric tool fine-tuning approach that jointly updates tool parameters to align training and inference processes, reducing the gap between pre-training and actual usage.
A dynamic integration framework for parameterized tools that allows LLMs to load and activate tool-specific parameter sets on demand, eliminating context-length-dependent inference overhead.

参数化工具微调方法：联合更新工具参数以对齐训练与推理过程，减少预训练与实际使用之间的性能差距

title: Planning with the Views via Scene Self-Exploration
summary: Can VLMs predict how each camera move changes the view, and plan many such moves ahead? We call this capability view planning, requiring (1)understanding how a single action transforms the view, and (2)composing many such transformations across multi-turn plans to identify a target view. We probe both abilities in our proposed ViewSuite, a 3D point-cloud environment on real ScanNet scenes. Across 13 frontier VLMs, a critical planning gap emerges: they possess basic view-action knowledge but fail to compose it across multi-turn plans, with the gap widening as viewpoint distance grows. To close this gap, we propose an iterative framework that alternates self-exploration with view graph distillation. The key insight is that all exploration trajectories, regardless of their outcome, collectively form a view graph that compactly captures how viewpoints connect across a scene. Distilling this graph into diverse supervised tasks reshapes the policy distribution and overcomes the sparse rewards that stall pure RL. This improves Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 2.5% to 47.8% on interactive view planning, surpassing GPT-5.4 Pro (18.5%) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (21.4%). Self-exploration emerges as a promising path toward VLMs that can actively reason and plan in 3D space.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ViewSuite评估框架，发现前沿VLM在视图规划中存在组合推理缺口，并提出一种迭代式自我探索与视图图蒸馏方法，显著提升了VLM在多步视图规划任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 当前VLM在单步视图变换理解上表现尚可，但在多步组合规划中存在严重不足，且缺乏标准化的评估基准来系统性地衡量这种能力。
AI.method: 首先构建ViewSuite（基于ScanNet场景的3D点云环境）评估13个前沿VLM的视图规划能力；然后提出迭代式自我探索与视图图蒸馏框架：所有探索轨迹（无论成功与否）共同构建视图图，通过蒸馏该图为多样化的监督任务来重塑策略分布，克服纯RL的稀疏奖励问题。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-VL-7B在交互式视图规划任务上从2.5%提升至47.8%，超过GPT-5.4 Pro（18.5%）和Gemini 3.1 Pro（21.4%）。
AI.conclusion: 自我探索是实现VLM在3D空间中主动推理和规划能力的有前景路径，视图图蒸馏能有效弥合多步规划的组合推理缺口。
idea_en: A view graph distillation method that constructs a view graph from all exploration trajectories (including failed ones) in a 3D scene, capturing how viewpoints connect, and distills this graph into diverse supervised tasks to reshape policy distribution.

An iterative self-exploration framework for Vision-Language Models that alternates between exploring 3D space and distilling exploration trajectories into training data, overcoming sparse reward problems in pure reinforcement learning.

ViewSuite: a 3D point-cloud evaluation environment built on real ScanNet scenes for systematically assessing view planning capabilities in VLMs, including single-action transformation understanding and multi-turn compositional planning.
idea_ch: 一种视图图蒸馏方法：通过收集3D场景中所有探索轨迹（包括失败的轨迹）构建视图图，捕获视点之间的连接关系，并将该图蒸馏为多样化的监督任务来重塑策略分布。
一种VLM迭代式自我探索框架：在3D空间中交替执行探索和将探索轨迹蒸馏为训练数据，克服纯强化学习中的稀疏奖励问题。
ViewSuite评估环境：基于真实ScanNet场景构建的3D点云环境，用于系统评估VLM的视图规划能力，包括单步动作变换理解和多步组合规划能力。
